events.title: West Harlem Summer Jazz Festival
events.description: Join West Harlem Arts Alliance, IAMCHELSEAIAM and NYC Parks for the annual jazz festival.    The Jazz Festival takes place in Morningside, St. Nicholas, Jackie Robinson from May to September. In Montefiore Square Park, the jazz festival is from June - August, weekly on Saturdays at 6 pm. In the Historic Harlem Parks of Morningside, St. Nicholas and Jackie Robinson, there are monthly jazz events. Morningside Park is typically second Saturdays from 5-6:30 pm at 113 Street and Morningside Ave, within the park. St. Nicholas is typically on fourth Fridays from 6-7:30 pm at the James Baldwin Lawn and 135 Street Plaza located at 135 Street and St. Nicholas Ave. Jackie Robinson Park is typically on first Fridays from 6-7:30 pm at the Bandshell, located at 148 Street and Bradhurst Ave. ADA access is located at 150 Street and Bradhurst Ave. Visit whaanyc.org for the full schedule of events and artist line up. August 8 at Morningside Park features Plena del Puente.
